records.name: Sorcrr
records.tagline: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm

Add your team, then vote, review, leverage ai assisted interviews, setup trials, send hiring offers, and you're done. One mobile first app with everything built in.

records.name: Quven

records.name: Blenny
records.tagline: Organize your macOS 27 menu bar without moving your pointer
records.description: Blenny is a free, open-source menu bar organizer for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 27. Keep essentials visible, reveal occasional apps with a click, and keep the rest hidden. Arrange apps in a draft, Apply when ready, and Undo the last change. No pointer movement, simulated clicks, or Screen Recording permission. Apache-2.0 licensed; self-signed, not Apple-notarized. The website has an interactive demo and the README lists compatibility limits.

records.name: NotchMate
records.tagline: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful.
records.description: NotchMate puts Notchy, a small furry monster, in your notch. It peeks, waves on unlock, wears glasses during focus, and goes quiet when you're busy. Open the notch for: -Music with album art and controls -Zen: synced karaoke lyrics or ambient visuals -Weather, calendar, Pomodoro -Clipboard history and file shelf -Window snap and camera mirror -Lid fold: the desktop folds as you close it Customize its color and fur. macOS 14+, works also without a notch, I added 9 languages.

records.name: Aperture
records.tagline: An AI code editor that checks its own work
records.description: Open-source AI code editor. Composer plans a change and stages it as a diff. Before you apply it, every change is checked: it parses, imports resolve, types check, the preview renders, and tests run. Tests run in your browser tab, free.

records.name: Control My Mac
records.tagline: A shortcut deck for every Mac app, on your iPhone or iPad
records.description: Control My Mac turns your iPhone or iPad into a trackpad, keyboard and shortcut deck for your Mac, built so the whole Mac works with one finger. Its Grid of shortcut buttons switches automatically to match the Mac app in front. Write long messages on your phone and send them in one go. Launch apps and switch windows. Pair with one QR scan: no account, no servers, no ads, and an encrypted direct connection. The Mac app is free.

records.name: Eat Train Feel
records.tagline: A coach for you Workouts, food, and how you feel
records.description: Build workouts from the equipment you own (AMRAP or rounds, a demo for every move), log food from 6,300 foods, track weight, sleep and HRV. A coach mode lets a personal trainer assign workouts and meal plans and see what was actually done. The Garmin app puts today's plan on your watch and saves it with a lap per exercise. Data is encrypted in your browser before it syncs. Free, no ads.

records.name: Smooth Recorder
records.tagline: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop
records.description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

records.name: Translate Like Me
records.tagline: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style
records.description: A menu bar app for macOS. Select text in any app, press a shortcut, and it is replaced with the translation. The direction between your two languages is detected automatically, and each pair can have its own writing style. Runs on Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, through the subscription you already have or your own API key. Free and open source.

records.name: Pixel Soup
records.tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
records.description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. Free to try for 3 days, no account and no card. Then one payment, no subscription.

records.name: LaunchReel
records.tagline: claude design but for editing professional videos faster.
records.description: LaunchReel is a Claude Code plugin that makes your videos: launch films and demos for your real product, written as code from your repo, and talking-head reels cut from your raw recordings. Claude does the work; LaunchReel adds a director's playbook, original music, voiceover and a studio to edit it yourself. Export 16:9 or 9:16, up to 4K.

records.name: Poddle
records.tagline: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer!
records.description: Poddle is Wii Sports-style pickleball for your browser, played only with the devices you already own. Open poddleball.com on any computer, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the paddle. On a Mac, one AirPod can be the paddle instead; a small open-source helper app streams its motion sensors to the game, and the other AirPod stays in the case. Play a friend online, take on Matt the bot at four difficulty levels, or run a tournament, and earn trophies as you go. 100% fun and free to play!

records.name: CoreSpeed
records.tagline: One MCP for everything your agents need: apps, memory, tools
records.description: CoreSpeed is an operating system for agents. Connect apps once and bring your accounts and shared or private memory to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP agents. Use multiple accounts per app, including X, with web search, social research and media generation built in. CoreSpeed holds app credentials. Budgets, activity logs and Smart Approval (beta) keep agents in check. Planned: Agent Drive, Mail, Pay, sandboxes, and more. Everything your agents need, through one MCP endpoint.

records.name: FlexChords
records.tagline: Turn any YouTube video into accurate, playable guitar chords
records.description: FlexChords turns any YouTube video or audio file into accurate, synchronized guitar chords in seconds. Unlike tools with noisy predictions or paywalls, FlexChords pairs deep learning with music-theory smoothing to eliminate glitches and deliver clean, musical progressions. Features include YouTube & audio chord detection, synced playback & real-time chords, interactive timeline with chord editor, key & tempo estimation. Instant access to unlimited catalog songs + 5 free custom scans (per month).

records.name: JOGAK
records.tagline: Make everyday vlogs with less editing
records.description: JOGAK is a vlog camera that joins the clips you record in shooting order. Capture everyday moments, review your timeline, adjust what you need, and save a finished video diary. Available for iPhone and Android. Free to download, with an ad option to export without the JOGAK logo.

records.name: Cursor Remote Lite
records.tagline: Use the Cursor on your computer from your phone
records.description: Leave your laptop behind and keep working. Drive the real Cursor on your computer from your phone: answer the Agent's questions, approve commands, give it the next task (queued while it's busy), keep or undo changed files. Works in local, SSH remote and Agents windows; switch model and effort. Push notifications when the Agent waits on you. Code stays on your computer; the phone connects via a Cloudflare tunnel. Android app + iPhone. Free, MIT, self-hosted.

records.name: TinyFolder
records.tagline: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way
records.description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

records.name: Rival Workshop
records.tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
records.description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

records.name: Sente
records.tagline: Talk to your coding agent
records.description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

records.name: DocsAlot MCP Connector

records.description: Create and update your knowledge base from Claude, Codex, or any compatible MCP client. Ask DocsAlot to add a page, fix an error, or improve your help center. It finds the relevant content, makes changes, creates a new version, and publishes, all from your existing workflow. See what questions users ask in your help center, discover what’s missing, and use those insights to improve your docs and decide what to build next.

records.name: opensend.cc
records.tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
records.description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

Fan-made, not affiliated with Rockstar.

records.name: Fermolog

records.name: Next Generation Agentic RAG
records.tagline: Cortex Agents filter out noise and recover missing context.
records.description: Get started in just three simple steps: create a vault with one of four embedding dimension options, add your files, and start a conversation. Holoora automatically handles the entire retrieval process for you, with zero code or complex setup.

records.name: Recora Screen

Projects stay on your Mac; export up to 4K.

records.name: AdForge

AdForge lets you pick a proven ad from the Meta and TikTok ad library, add your own product photos, screenshots or clips, and get a finished video ad that follows the same hook and pacing: script, AI voiceover, captions and music included. You see the credit cost before scenes render, failed shots are refunded, and there are no auto top-ups. Built for solo DTC founders who make their own ads.

records.name: Stresix
records.tagline: Load test your app, get the server size it needs
records.description: Point Stresix at a GitHub repo or Docker image. It runs your app on a fresh server, hits it with up to 10,000 users from a second one, measures CPU per core and memory, and tells you if your server is enough. No scripts. ~10 minutes. From $1.60 a run.

records.name: Trao
records.tagline: Tagline cannot be longer than 60 characters

records.name: Algomaya
records.tagline: Paper trade stocks and build algo bots without coding
records.description: Algomaya is a free paper trading app for practicing stock trading with $100K virtual money and building algo bots without code. Visual strategy builder with 15+ indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands), backtesting on real historical data, 50+ ready-made strategies, AI trading assistant, daily quizzes, and real-time portfolio tracking. Built for beginners learning to trade and intermediate traders looking to automate.

records.name: FORM
records.tagline: One personalized system for your whole health
records.description: Most health apps understand one part of you. FORM connects the whole picture. It brings nutrition, workouts, activity, sleep and recovery together to build a personalized model of your health. Instead of just showing you more data, FORM helps you understand what it means and what to do next: from what to eat and how to train to when to prioritize recovery.

records.name: JNX Global: Real-Time TikTok API
records.tagline: TikTok analytics API that bypasses 403/429 blocks
records.description: A dedicated API for real-time TikTok analytics, hashtags, and creator stats directly from the source. Standard scrapers break constantly under TikTok's heavy anti-bot security. JNX Global uses a programmatic validation loop that mimics organic behavior to guarantee clean, un-cached data with a 100% success rate. Tradeoff: requests take ~30 seconds to bypass blocks. Built for high-accuracy bulk data collection and product research. Free basic tier available on RapidAPI.

records.name: Push Notification - Client
records.tagline: Receive a test Apple push while you write the server.

It shows the device token, bundle identifier, and certificate details your server should target, plus short samples for Java, Go, Python, Ruby, Erlang, and Node.js. Run your code and see whether the push arrived. It does not send notifications and is not a user dashboard.

records.name: Cloudex Marketing

records.description: Cloudex Marketing is the fastest growing SEO Company in Pakistan. records.name: Boounce

records.name: Atendio

Built in Medellín, Colombia, for businesses in Latin America. 14-day free trial.

records.name: Winter Arc
records.tagline: Free 90-day self-improvement tracker for your Winter Arc
records.description: Winter Arc is a free self-improvement tracker for 90-day challenges like the Winter Arc trend. Pick a few goals, tap them when they're done, and watch your streak and progress grow. Steps, water and minutes fill a progress ring, rest days keep streaks fair, and you can share your day as a story image. Works on any phone, no ads.

records.name: phyphox

records.description: Download for free: Follow us: Features Sensors Phyphox allows you to use the sensors in your phone for your experiments. For example, detect the frequency of a pendulum using the accelerometer or measure the Doppler effect using its microphone. Data Export Export your data i

records.name: MyCup.Me 2.0
records.tagline: Professional Tournament Management Software
records.description: MyCup is the all-in-one platform behind serious tournaments — multi-division structures, team panels, live standings, and a professional public website. Free to start.

records.name: Vaniger

records.description: Vaniger is an AI power dialer with a live AI teleprompter that tells you exactly what to say, in real time, on every call. records.name: KittyHome Community
records.tagline: Learn, chat and play with developers in a 3D cat world

Between questions, do daily duties, play arcade trivia, join treasure hunts and the Weekend Cup, and spend the coins you earn on hats and new characters, each with its own special move.

records.name: Aurora

Before generating the final pixels, the tool uses a custom cryptographic pipeline to obfuscate and secure the raw data. Perfect for steganography, data obfuscation, or exploring new visual storage formats. Feel free to audit the code on GitHub!

records.name: African Print

records.name: 3am Archive: Sleep Detective

An optional AI cat, off by default, can reply to what you wrote.

records.name: Xpoudy

records.name: Moot
records.tagline: Your friends’ public conversations, together
records.description: Moot brings your friends’ public conversations across Reddit, X, Instagram, Threads and Bluesky together. Follow chronologically, discover public communities, and read discussions without an account. An optional extension shares supported posts and replies when you like or reply; reading alone shares nothing. No ads or trackers. Early MVP; Chrome and Firefox extensions currently require manual installation.

records.name: Novus Aegis AI
records.tagline: Catch attackers before they strike.

Decoys indistinguishable from real systems engage attackers directly, mapping every move to MITRE ATT&CK in real time. Compromised systems get quarantined in under 30 seconds, automatically. Every alert across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and insider threat is fully investigated by AI. Deploys agentless in 48 hours.

records.name: Croppo
records.tagline: A platform that lets Romanian farmers sell without middlemen

Farmers keep ~90% of each sale vs. under 14% through supermarkets, and buyers get farm-fresh food at farm prices. Launching soon across Romania.

records.name: Pace & Fuel
records.tagline: Free running plans with built-in fueling & calendar sync
records.description: Most running plans are rigid PDFs with zero race-day nutrition guidance. records.name: Paidaro
records.tagline: Get paid faster with smarter invoice collections

Start free with up to 10 active invoices.

records.description: Halvsy turns a photo of the bill into a group balance. It reads every line, tax and tip, and checks them against the printed total. Friends join with a QR code, each group keeps its own currency, and settling up goes through whatever payment app you already use. No ads and no daily limit on expenses.

records.name: Kist Net Worth

ManageCal makes it easier to coordinate schedules, book resources, manage shifts, plan events, and keep teams organised.

records.name: Enpix

records.description: Improve photo clarity, detail, and color with Enpix AI image enhancer. Upload a photo, compare the result, and download when it looks right.

records.tagline: Agent V is a desktop coding agent.
records.description: Agent V is a desktop coding agent. Write what you want and how you will know it is done; it does the work and shows you every step.

records.name: Image Optimizer
records.tagline: Free WordPress image optimizer with no monthly limits
records.description: What it does: - Optimizes automatically on upload (async or sync) - Bulk optimization with progress and resume, via a background queue - Optional WebP and AVIF versions - Optional backups before replacing originals - Full control over quality, resize rules, metadata, formats and batch size - Dashboard: images optimized, bytes saved, compression rate, queue status If you've used Smush, ShortPixel or Imagify, what would make you switch, or not?

records.name: Nerelune: Secrets of the Cove
records.tagline: Restore a seaside resort through portrait merge gameplay
records.description: Nerelune: Secrets of the Cove is a portrait merge adventure where you combine objects, fulfill character orders and restore a mysterious seaside resort.

records.name: Themesmith
records.tagline: The web agency made of software, run by message
records.description: Themesmith designs, builds and looks after websites for small businesses, entirely by message. Owners talk to it over WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram or email. It asks about the business, recommends pages, offers design directions to choose from, then builds and publishes. After launch, a tradesperson can send photos from the van and they're on the site minutes later. No app and no dashboard to learn, though there is one if you want it. Plans from £15 a month.

records.name: Lovely
records.tagline: 90+ free couple games to play online, no sign-up
records.description: Lovely is a free collection of 90+ games for couples that run right in the browser. Would You Rather, Truth or Dare, This or That, deep questions, long distance games and a lot more. No account, no download: open it on date night or share the link over a video call. There's also a companion iOS and Android app with home screen widgets (countdown, shared drawing, distance between you) and a daily question you both answer.

records.name: AppScreenshoot
records.tagline: app store screenshoot
records.description: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots with editable templates. Browse templates, choose iPhone, iPad or Android sizes and export your screenshot set.
